The Centre for Interdisciplinary Women’s and Gender Studies at Carl von Ossietzky University Oldenburg (ZFG) is a forum for inter- and transdisciplinary Gender Studies. The ZFG is the central space at the university for researchers, young academics, students, and other professionals.
